items.title: Kering stock extends recent slide as luxury weakness weighs on valuation
items.summary: Kering shares fell from EUR283.50 (Aug 11) to EUR257.10 (Aug 17), a roughly 9.3% slide in under a week, closing down 4.26% on Aug 17 alone and leaving the group's market value in the low-30-billion-euro range. Broader luxury stocks also fell around 2% that day. Gucci, as flagship brand and primary revenue driver, was cited as the practical gauge of the group's underlying business strength amid investor concern over discretionary spending.

items.title: Kering Shares Surge 15% on Gucci's Promising Turnaround Momentum
items.summary: WWD reports Kering shares jumped as much as 15% following Q2 results that showed Gucci's sales decline slowing more than analysts expected, alongside revenue beating consensus estimates. Coverage frames Gucci's leather goods launches (Borsetto, Paparazzo bags) as central to the improved trajectory, while cautioning the recovery remains early-stage.

items.title: Kering Group Q2 Earnings 2026: Revenues Up 1% as Gucci Improves
items.summary: Kering posted Q2 2026 revenue of EUR3.65 billion, up 2% comparable, slightly ahead of the EUR3.63 billion analyst consensus. Gucci's organic revenue decline narrowed to 2% as leather goods returned to growth on the Borsetto and Paparazzo bag launches, beating the 4.7% decline analysts had forecast. Recurring operating margin rose to 12.8%, up 40bps YoY. Separately, Q2 North America comparable sales rose 3.7%, an acceleration from 0.5% in Q1, one of the more encouraging regional data points in the release.

items.title: "Zombie Land": viral video comparing Gucci's 1995 vs 2025 male models sparks reactions
items.summary: A short-form video juxtaposing Gucci's 1995 (Tom Ford-era) male model Jason Lewis against a 2025/2026-era Gucci male model circulated on TikTok/X, sparking a heated comment debate about declining male beauty/casting standards at the house under Demna. Reactions skewed mixed-to-critical, with many commenters describing the newer casting as gaunt by comparison.
